_why: The real ProjectSetupPanel (T6) gives every project the SAME generic toggle aria-label ('Inbox in this project') — proving two projects hold independent choices needs document-order indexing, not a per-project aria-label the old mockup used to have. R19 grading pass (2026-09-24): the original single shot here only asserted the post-toggle split (false/true), which reads identically whether the starting state was correctly off->on or (the actual bug) already-on toggled on->off — it never independently proved the STARTING state. Split into a pre-toggle shot that pins 'off everywhere' before anything is clicked, then the post-toggle shot with its expectation corrected to match that real starting state (click affects only the clicked project's toggle).
